[EN] Day 21

I shouldn't have believed him. How could I have thought trusting a man who worked with the archdevans was a good idea? It was suspicious from the start—I should have known better.Open the book.Read the next page.
[ES] Día 21

No debí haberle creído. ¿Cómo pude pensar que confiar en un hombre que trabajaba con los archidemonios era una buena idea? Era sospechoso desde el principio; debí habérmelo olido.Open the book.Read the next page.

[EN] Day 33

Dakyuron is now experimenting on humans. The finest among the Khirians have been imprisoned. They're all innocent—just like Syona.Read the next page.
[ES] Día 33

Dakyuron ahora está experimentando con humanos. Los mejores entre los Khirians han sido encarcelados. Todos son inocentes, al igual que Syona.Read the next page.

[EN] Day 57

I failed Syona. Unbelievable. If only I knew how to use magic or...something. Anything. I could have done something.

I hear Syona screaming every time I close my eyes.Read the next page.
[ES] Día 57

Le fallé a Syona. Increíble. Si tan solo supiera usar magia o... algo. Cualquier cosa. Podría haber hecho algo.

Escucho a Syona gritar cada vez que cierro los ojos.Read the next page.

[EN] My dear Syona,

Forgive me. There was nothing I could do. I let you down.

I'll find a way to make up for this. I will. Just...please...Finish reading the book.
[ES] Mi querida Syona,

Perdóname. No había nada que pudiera hacer. Te he fallado.

Encontraré la manera de enmendar esto. Lo haré. Solo... por favor...Finish reading the book.
